text_block_list.text:
As I was walking, I thought I heard
a familiar voice from somewhere...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Someone, help meee!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Hnnnnnngh!!

Rushing over to the sound of someone calling for help,
I found Taiki Shuttle pulling on the vines in the field.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... Trainer!
Help meeeee!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"The Chairwoman asked me
to harvest some pumpkins, YES!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeees! My hometown is
famous for its pumpkin festival!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
There's a contest for the biggest pumpkin,
and even a race where you carry them while running!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
There was even an outdoor live concert—singing and dancing,
it was so exciting!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
When I heard 'pumpkin', I just couldn't sit still,
so I volunteered to take it on!
choice_data_list: You can put your festival experience to good use!
You can put your festival experience to good use!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
But... come to think of it, I had
zero experience harvesting pumpkins, you know.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I used to take part in the festival every single year without fail, but...
ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: —So, please help me, Trainer-saaan!!
choice_data_list: I'll show you how it's done!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"A match...?"
Which means—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: You mean we are competing to see who can harvest faster between you and me, Trainer, YES!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
That sounds like FUN!
I won't LOSE, YES!!
Afterward, Taiki Shuttle and I competed to see who could harvest more pumpkins, bringing the harvest to a fun conclusion.

And so, I ended up helping Taiki Shuttle
with the pumpkin harvest, but...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! I see!
So that's how you create an opening, yes?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Looks like this could be useful in races too, YES?!
Shall we start training right AWAY?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Ugh... Haaai.

Though we both ended up covered in mud while harvesting
pumpkins, it seems to have been a fruitful experience.
